activities.title: Puddle route walk
activities.what_to_do: Walk a route chosen for its obstacles — puddles, kerbs, low walls, steps.

activities.title: Twenty throws and catches
activities.what_to_do: Twenty throws, counted aloud, stopping at twenty whether or not it is going well.

activities.title: Ten minutes of block play
activities.what_to_do: Build, knock down, rebuild. The rebuilding is the part that counts.

activities.title: Bare feet on grass
activities.what_to_do: Ten minutes outside with nothing on their feet.

activities.title: Cook something with a knife
activities.what_to_do: A real task with a real blade, supervised from start to finish.
activities.you_will_need: A blunt knife and something soft

activities.title: Scissors and an old magazine
activities.what_to_do: Cutting anything they like out of something they are allowed to destroy.

activities.title: Best bit, worst bit
activities.what_to_do: Each person says one good and one hard thing about the day. The adult goes first.

activities.title: Tell someone else what happened
activities.what_to_do: They retell one thing from the day to a person who was not there.

activities.title: Give the directions
activities.what_to_do: They direct you somewhere familiar and you do exactly as told.

activities.title: Explain it to the toy
activities.what_to_do: They explain a game or a rule to a teddy while you listen.

activities.title: Two minutes, no notes
activities.what_to_do: They talk for two timed minutes about something they care about.

activities.title: Name the feeling before the nap
activities.what_to_do: Say aloud what you think they are feeling, before rest time.

activities.title: Lose a game on purpose
activities.what_to_do: Play something you will win, and stay with them through losing.

activities.title: The rewind
activities.what_to_do: After a wobble, retell it calmly: what happened, what it felt like, what helped.

activities.title: Angry on paper
activities.what_to_do: Paper and a pen, and permission to scribble the feeling out.

activities.title: Twenty minutes before answering
activities.what_to_do: Agree not to reply to something that landed hard for twenty minutes.

activities.title: Pack your own bag
activities.what_to_do: They pack from a list they can read, and nobody checks it.

activities.title: Their own cup and a small jug
activities.what_to_do: Pouring their own drink at meals, spills included.

activities.title: Make the same meal each week
activities.what_to_do: One simple meal, repeated weekly until it belongs to them.

activities.title: The errand alone
activities.what_to_do: One short trip done without you.

activities.title: Dressed before breakfast
activities.what_to_do: Clothes out the night before, dressing before food, no clock running.

activities.title: Invite one friend, not three
activities.what_to_do: One friend, at home, for a short visit.

activities.title: Play alongside another child
activities.what_to_do: Near another child with similar toys, and no requirement to share.

activities.title: Host it themselves
activities.what_to_do: They plan and run an activity for a friend from start to finish.

activities.title: Write to someone far away
activities.what_to_do: A card or drawing for someone they do not see often.

activities.title: One story with a rhyme in it
activities.what_to_do: Any book where they can finish the line for you.

activities.title: Read to the dog
activities.what_to_do: Reading aloud to a pet, a toy or a patient sibling.

activities.title: You read one, I read one
activities.what_to_do: Alternate pages so the story keeps moving.

activities.title: Twenty minutes, their choice
activities.what_to_do: Anything they choose, including comics and match reports.

activities.title: Write a real letter
activities.what_to_do: To a real person who will really reply.

activities.title: Set the table
activities.what_to_do: They work out how many plates, cups and forks are needed.

activities.title: Pay with the coins
activities.what_to_do: They hand over real money and work out the change.

activities.title: Double the recipe
activities.what_to_do: Halve or double something and work out the new amounts together.

activities.title: Guess then measure
activities.what_to_do: Guess a length or a weight, then measure it.

activities.title: Count the stairs
activities.what_to_do: Count aloud on the stairs, the same way every time.

activities.title: Grow one fast thing
activities.what_to_do: Plant cress or beans and check them daily.

activities.title: Dig a patch of soil
activities.what_to_do: A patch of ground and something to dig with.

activities.title: Draw the map of here
activities.what_to_do: Draw your street or the route to school together.

activities.title: Take something apart
activities.what_to_do: Something broken and safe, dismantled properly.

activities.title: Follow one news story
activities.what_to_do: Pick a story and follow it for a fortnight.

activities.title: The box is a boat
activities.what_to_do: A big box, and nothing said about what it is.

activities.title: Junk model
activities.what_to_do: Packaging, tape, and no instructions.

activities.title: Draw the story you just read
activities.what_to_do: After a book, draw the part they liked.

activities.title: The six-box comic
activities.what_to_do: Six boxes, one story, words optional.

activities.title: Learn one riff
activities.what_to_do: One short piece of music, learned properly, on anything.

activities.title: Make up the verse
activities.what_to_do: Take a song they know and change the words together.

activities.title: Say the sound back
activities.what_to_do: Repeat their babble back and leave a gap long enough to feel awkward.

activities.title: Name what they are looking at
activities.what_to_do: Follow their eyes and say the thing. One word, no sentence.

activities.title: Sing the ordinary
activities.what_to_do: Sing what you are doing rather than saying it.

activities.title: One pot of paint
activities.what_to_do: One colour, big paper, hands allowed.

activities.title: Bang something together
activities.what_to_do: Wooden spoons, pans, boxes — and you joining in rather than supervising.

activities.title: Let them hold the spoon
activities.what_to_do: Their own spoon at mealtimes, even though it will not work yet.

activities.title: One job at bathtime
activities.what_to_do: One part of the routine that is genuinely theirs.

activities.title: Pause before helping
activities.what_to_do: Count to five before stepping in on anything they are struggling with.

activities.title: Face to face, no screen
activities.what_to_do: Ten minutes of nothing but looking at each other and copying faces.

activities.title: Peekaboo until they stop
activities.what_to_do: Play until they are bored rather than until you are.

activities.title: Watch other children
activities.what_to_do: Sit where other children are playing, and just watch together.

activities.title: Out in the weather
activities.what_to_do: Go outside in whatever it is doing, and name it.

activities.title: The same short walk
activities.what_to_do: The same route regularly, pointing at the same things.

activities.title: What does it do?
activities.what_to_do: Let them work taps, switches, lids and catches.

activities.title: Floor time, nothing propping
activities.what_to_do: Ten minutes flat on the floor beside them, no seat, no support.

activities.title: The same book again
activities.what_to_do: Read the one they keep choosing, as often as they choose it.

activities.title: Point at the words
activities.what_to_do: Run a finger under the words as you read them.

activities.title: Leave the last word
activities.what_to_do: Read a rhyme they know and stop before the rhyming word.

activities.title: Two of everything
activities.what_to_do: Hand things over in twos, saying “two” as you do.

activities.title: Big one, little one
activities.what_to_do: Sort the washing, the shoes or the spoons into big and little.

activities.title: Name it before the nap
activities.what_to_do: As they get tired, say what you see. “You’re tired. It’s hard.”

activities.title: Wait for the sand timer
activities.what_to_do: A two-minute timer for turns, with you sitting alongside while it runs.

activities.title: Something neither of you can do
activities.what_to_do: Try a sport or activity that is new to both of you, together.

activities.title: Walk it instead of driving
activities.what_to_do: One journey a week done on foot or by bike that would normally be a car.

activities.title: Read the same thing and argue
activities.what_to_do: Read the same book or article and disagree about it.

activities.title: Two sources, one story
activities.what_to_do: Two accounts of the same event, and find where they differ.

activities.title: Is that number honest?
activities.what_to_do: Take a statistic from an advert and pull it apart together.

activities.title: Say no to a friend
activities.what_to_do: Rehearse turning down something a friend wants, without falling out.

activities.title: The long project
activities.what_to_do: One thing that takes more than one sitting, kept somewhere they can see it.

activities.title: Manage one thing all week
activities.what_to_do: Hand over a recurring responsibility entirely, not task by task.
